Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg., cor EDSA Mapagmahal Street, Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG PINION NO. JUN 22 PUNONG BARANGAY TERESITA P. INSON Barangay Kalagangan San Fernando, Bukidnon Dear PB Inson: 98 s. 2010 This concerns your Resolution No. 66, series of 2009, entitled: "RESOLUTION REQUESTING APPROVAL OF HER EXCELLENCY GLORIA MACAPAGAL CONGRESSMAN OF THE 2ND DISTRICT OF BUKIDNON FOR THE CREATION OF BARANGAY KALAGANGAN AND ITS THIRTEEN (13) ADJOINING BARANGAYS NAMELY: MATUPE, DURIAN, CABULING, BULALANG, PALACPACAN, DAO, CAYAGA, SAN JOSE, STO. DOMINGO, BONACAO, NAMNAM, IGLUGSAD AND KIBONGCOG OF SAN FERNANDO, BUKIDNON INTO A MUNICIPALITY." Said Resolution was referred to this Department for appropriate action by Atty. Lynn Danao-Moreno, Assistant Secretary, Government Administration Office, Office of the President. At the outset, in our DILG Opinion No. 69 series of 2004 dated 18 August 2004, we provide therein the pertinent provisions of the 1987 Constitution and Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) relative to the manner of creation, division, merger, abolition, or substantial alteration of boundaries of a local government units. In reply to your concern, please be informed that with respect to the conversion of a local government unit, the requirements for the creation of local government units also apply (The Local Government Code of 1991; Aquilino Q. Pimentel, Jr., p. 34). Hence, Section 441 of the Local Government Code, provides and we quote: "Section 441. Manner of Creation. — A municipality may be created, divided, merged, abolished, or its boundary

substantially altered only by an Act of Congress and subject to the approval by a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be conducted by the COMELEC in the local government unit or units directly affected. Except as otherwise provided in the said Act, the plebiscite shall be held within one hundred twenty (120) days from the date of its effectively". From the aforecited provision of law, it is evident that a municipality may be created only by an Act of Congress and subject to the approval by a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite. From this, it is proper for you to addressed your concern to the House of Representatives for the conversion of your barangay into a municipality. A copy of the DILG Opinion No. 69, series of 2004 is hereto attached for your ready perusal. Thank you. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: ATT Legal:28/corz 75 ESUS B. DOQUE IV irector Ill
